Compare eight Tailgate configurations with the manual gating of the ACS CyTOF
dataset and select one for the method comparison in Analysis 9b. The eight are
four parameter sets, each estimated with and without cells whose expression is
exactly zero. Selection uses the manual frequencies that Analysis 9b and
Analysis 10 then compare against, so Tailgate's results there are in-sample:
splitting the selection and the comparison into two documents does not make
the comparison an independent validation.

## Set-up

`RUN_SIMULATIONS=true` preprocesses every population into its cached
GatingSet (shared with Analysis 9b), runs the eight Tailgate configurations
and saves the selection; `RUN_SIMULATIONS=false RUN_PLOTS=true` reads the
saved selection. `RUN_PREPROCESSING` and `RUN_COMPARATORS` override those
stages when supplied. Computation needs the same inputs as Analysis 9b: the
population FCS directories under the `raw-data-large/comparison_data/acscytof/fcs`
projr path, the manual `Cytokines_10Jun2021_2.csv` under
`raw-data-small/comparison_data/acscytof` and the filename map from
`DataTidyACSCyTOFFAUST`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

root_dir <- normalizePath(if (file.exists("DESCRIPTION")) "." else "..", winslash = "/")
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(root_dir, "DESCRIPTION")))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root_dir)

scripts_r_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "scripts", "r")
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "analysis-runtime.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "analysis-plot-style.R"))
fig_key <- .analysis_mode_key("9a-real-tune-acs-cytof-tailgate", sized = FALSE)
analysis_qmd <- "analysis/9a-real-tune-acs-cytof-tailgate.qmd"
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-helper.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-preprocess.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-gate.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "sim-misc.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "sim-compare-freq_bs.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-methods.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-manual.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-plot_cyt.R"))
source(file.path(scripts_r_dir, "acs_cytof-tailgate-select.R"))

run_simulations <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env(
  "run_simulations", "RUN_SIMULATIONS", FALSE
))
run_preprocessing <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env(
  "run_preprocessing", "RUN_PREPROCESSING", run_simulations
))
run_comparators <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env(
  "run_comparators", "RUN_COMPARATORS", run_simulations
))
run_plots <- .as_flag(.get_qmd_param_env("run_plots", "RUN_PLOTS", TRUE))
n_workers <- as.integer(.get_qmd_param_env("n_workers", "ACS_N_WORKERS", 2L))
if (is.na(n_workers) || n_workers < 1L) {
  stop("n_workers must be coercible to an integer of at least one.")
}

.acsCytofEnsureCurrentCheckout(root_dir)

path_fcs_base <- projr::projr_path_get(
  "raw-data-large", "comparison_data", "acscytof", "fcs",
  format = "absolute"
)
if (isTRUE(run_preprocessing) && !dir.exists(path_fcs_base)) {
  stop("Path to FCS files does not exist: ", path_fcs_base)
}
path_gs_base <- projr::projr_path_get("cache", "acs_cytof", "gs", format = "absolute")
path_scratch_base <- projr::projr_path_get(
  "cache", "acs_cytof", "scratch", format = "absolute"
)
path_selection <- .acsCytofTailgateSelectionDir(root_dir)
# Thesis-ready figures and the Typst table go to the projr "output-thesis"
# label (_output/thesis, uploaded to a GitHub release on projr builds), in its
# appendix folder (quick/dev renders in a subfolder); the HTML shows the
# standard figures.
thesis_parts <- c("appendix", fig_key[-1L])
if (isTRUE(run_comparators) && !requireNamespace("cytoUtils", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The Tailgate comparison requires the cytoUtils package.")
}
```

## Scientific settings

```{r}
#| label: scientific-settings
pop_vec <- c("tcrgd", "cd4", "cd8", "nk", "nk_pre", "b")
analysis_seed <- 20260823L
tailgate_configs <- .acsCytofTailgateConfigs()
```

The four parameter sets are:

| Configuration | Automatic tolerance | Tolerance | Bias |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Simulation-selected (Analyses 6 and 7) | Yes | 0.01 | 0.1 |
| Automatic-tolerance reference (formerly "default settings") | Yes | 0.01 | 0 |
| ACS-tuned (previous Analysis 9) | No | $2\times10^{-5}$ | 0.2 |
| cytoUtils package default | No | 0.01 | 0 |

With automatic tolerance, the tolerance is a multiple of the largest absolute
first derivative of the density (a relative tolerance: 0.01 means 1%);
without it, the tolerance is an absolute bound on the derivative, so it
depends on the scale of the data. The cytoUtils package default is the
default of `cytoUtils:::.cytokine_cutpoint()` (`tol = 0.01`,
`auto_tol = FALSE`); the version used is recorded with the selection and
printed below. The bias moves the cutpoint up, as StimGate's gates are moved
up by its bias.

Each set is estimated twice: on every cell, and after removing cells with an
expression of exactly zero (over half of the cells for some cytokines, all
clearly negative). Removing zeros affects only the estimation of the
threshold. Every threshold is then applied to all cells of the stimulated
and unstimulated tubes, so frequencies keep the same denominators and the
same background subtraction for every configuration. All configurations use
the stimulated tube, the first-derivative method, one reference peak,
`adjust = 1`, the plug-in bandwidth from `ks::hpi()` and `strict = FALSE`
(cytoUtils' own default, `strict = TRUE`, only turns a missing reference peak
into an error).

$F_{\beta}$ ($\beta=0.8$) is not tuned here; Analysis 9b keeps its existing
CyTOF adaptation.

## Preprocessing

Each population's FCS files are read into a cached GatingSet, which Analysis 9b
reuses.

```{r}
#| label: preprocess-populations
#| include: false
if (isTRUE(run_preprocessing)) {
  preprocessing_runs <- .acsCytofMapPopulations(
    pop_vec,
    function(pop) {
      .acsCytofRunPopulationSafe(
        pop = pop, pathFcsBase = path_fcs_base, pathGsBase = path_gs_base,
        pathScratchBase = path_scratch_base, runPreprocessing = TRUE,
        runMethods = FALSE, runPlots = FALSE
      )
    },
    nWorkers = n_workers, seed = analysis_seed,
    label = "ACS population preprocessing"
  )
}
```

## Tailgate configurations

All eight configurations run for every population, concurrently across
populations. Each is saved to its own `result.rds` once all eight have
finished, so a failed rerun keeps the last good results.

```{r}
#| label: run-tailgate-configurations
#| include: false
if (isTRUE(run_comparators)) {
  tailgate_runs <- .acsCytofMapPopulations(
    pop_vec,
    function(pop) {
      .acsCytofRunComparisonMethodsSafe(
        pop = pop, pathFcsBase = path_fcs_base, pathGsBase = path_gs_base,
        pathScratchBase = path_scratch_base, runMethods = TRUE,
        methods = .acsCytofTailgateSelectionMethods()
      )
    },
    nWorkers = n_workers, seed = analysis_seed,
    label = "ACS Tailgate configuration runs"
  )
}
```

## Scoring and selection

Each configuration's frequencies are compared with the manual frequencies as
in Analysis 10. Scoring uses every population/cytokine/stimulus stratum that
passes the manuscript signal eligibility rule: the 75th percentile of the
manual stimulated frequency exceeds three times the larger of 0.01% and the
median manual unstimulated frequency, and the 75th percentile of the manual
background-subtracted frequency exceeds 0.02%. As in the heatmaps, the
non-secreted-protein stimulus (`p4`) is left out. All matched populations
count (CD4, CD8 and TCRgd T cells, B cells and NK cells; `nk_pre` has no
manual population).

Within each stratum, every configuration is scored on the same donors: those
whose gates succeeded under all eight configurations. Failed gates stay
missing and never count as zero frequencies. The selected configuration has
the highest arithmetic mean PCC over the strata, each weighted equally. A
stratum counts only if every configuration's PCC is defined there, so losing
a difficult stratum cannot raise one configuration's mean; the table reports
how many strata were scored and how many gates failed. An exact tie for the
highest mean, or no scored stratum, selects nothing, and Analysis 9b then
stops. Concordance correlation (CCC) and mean absolute frequency error are
reported beside PCC as diagnostics: PCC does not penalise a systematic offset
or rescaling.

```{r}
#| label: score-and-select
#| include: false
if (isTRUE(run_preprocessing) || isTRUE(run_comparators)) {
  data("fn_to_sampleid_map", package = "DataTidyACSCyTOFFAUST")
  selection_comparison_tbl <- comp_against_manual_cyt(
    fn = "Cytokines_10Jun2021_2.csv",
    path_scratch_base = path_scratch_base,
    path_fcs_base = path_fcs_base,
    pop = pop_vec,
    methods = .acsCytofTailgateSelectionMethods(),
    path_dir_save = NULL,
    save_plots = FALSE,
    sample_map = fn_to_sampleid_map
  )
  strata_tbl <- .acsCytofTailgateScoreStrata(selection_comparison_tbl)
  ranking_tbl <- .acsCytofTailgateRanking(strata_tbl)
  selection <- .acsCytofTailgateSelectionRecord(
    ranking_tbl, selection_comparison_tbl,
    runId = .sanitize_run_id(Sys.getenv("ANALYSIS_RUN_ID", unset = ""))
  )
  # Build the whole folder before replacing the last good selection.
  .acsCytofReplaceDir(path_selection, function(path_tmp) {
    .write_rds_atomic(selection_comparison_tbl, file.path(path_tmp, "comparison.rds"))
    .write_rds_atomic(strata_tbl, file.path(path_tmp, "strata.rds"))
    .write_rds_atomic(selection, file.path(path_tmp, "selection.rds"))
  })
} else {
  selection <- .analysis_read_rds(
    file.path(path_selection, "selection.rds"), "acs_cytof", analysis_qmd
  )
  .analysis_check_expected_run(
    selection, "acs_cytof", analysis_qmd,
    semantics_version = .acsCytofTailgateSelectionSemantics()
  )
  if (!identical(selection$configs, tailgate_configs)) {
    .analysis_cache_error("acs_cytof",
      "The saved selection used other Tailgate configurations.", analysis_qmd)
  }
  strata_tbl <- .analysis_read_rds(
    file.path(path_selection, "strata.rds"), "acs_cytof", analysis_qmd
  )
  ranking_tbl <- selection$ranking
}
correlation_tbl <- .acsCytofTailgateCorrelationTable(strata_tbl)
```

## Results

### Ranking

```{r}
#| label: show-selection
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat(
  "\nSelection: **", selection$status, "**",
  if (identical(selection$status, "selected")) {
    paste0(" (", .acsCytofValidationMethodLabels()[[selection$method]], ", `", selection$method, "`)")
  } else if (length(selection$tied)) {
    paste0(" between ", paste0("`", selection$tied, "`", collapse = ", "))
  },
  ". cytoUtils ", selection$cytoUtils$version,
  if (!is.null(selection$cytoUtils$sha)) paste0(" (", substr(selection$cytoUtils$sha, 1, 7), ")"),
  "; selection saved ", format(selection$createdAt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
  if (length(selection$run_id)) paste0(", run `", selection$run_id, "`"), ".\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

Strata scored counts eligible strata in which every configuration has a PCC
on the shared donors, out of all eligible strata. Failed gates counts failed
donor/cytokine estimates in eligible strata, out of all of them. Analysis 9b
reads the saved selection, including whether zeros are removed.

```{r}
#| label: ranking-table
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  print(knitr::kable(.acsCytofTailgateHtmlTable(ranking_tbl), format = "pipe", escape = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
  .analysis_report_table(
    ranking_tbl |> dplyr::select(
      rank, method, config, removeZero, autoTol, tol, bias, mean_pcc,
      n_scored, n_eligible, n_defined, n_undefined, n_failed, n_rows,
      n_common, mean_ccc, mean_abs_diff, mean_pcc_own, n_pcc_own, best
    ),
    c(fig_key, "tailgate-ranking.csv"),
    paste(
      "Ranking with coverage and diagnostics: mean CCC and mean absolute",
      "frequency error on the scored strata, and each configuration's mean",
      "PCC on its own successful donors (`mean_pcc_own`, over `n_pcc_own` strata)."
    ),
    path_root = root_dir
  )
  .analysis_report_table(
    strata_tbl, c(fig_key, "tailgate-strata.csv"),
    "PCC, CCC, donor coverage and failures per stratum and configuration.",
    path_root = root_dir
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: typst-table

if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  typst_source <- .acsCytofTailgateTypst(ranking_tbl)
  writeLines(typst_source, file.path(

```

### Correlation heatmaps

One heatmap per configuration, in the layout of Analysis 10: cytokines across
columns, populations down rows and a panel per stimulus. Colour and text show
PCC on the donors shared by all configurations, the values the ranking
averages, on a common scale from -1 to 1. Light-grey cells labelled `excl.`
are strata excluded by the eligibility rule; white cells labelled `NA` are
eligible strata where the PCC is undefined. Blank positions have no matched
stratum.

Thesis versions are saved as PDF and 300 dpi PNG at the thesis's text width
(146.5 mm: A4 with 1.5 in left and 1 in other margins), 62 mm high for the
T-cell populations and 82 mm for all populations, under
`appendix/acs-tailgate-heatmaps/` in the projr `output-thesis` folder
(`_output/thesis`). Their text is 7–8.5 pt at that size; the eligibility key
is left out, so their caption should explain the `excl.` and `NA` cells.

```{r}
#| label: tailgate-heatmaps
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(run_plots)) {
  for (real_only in c(TRUE, FALSE)) {
    .analysis_heading(
      if (real_only) "CD4, CD8 and TCRgd T cells" else "All matched populations", 4
    )
    pops_key <- if (real_only) "real-pops" else "all-pops"
    for (method in tailgate_configs$method) {
      .analysis_heading(.acsCytofValidationMethodLabels()[[method]], 5)
      p <- .acsCytofValidationPlotCorrelation(
        correlation_tbl, method = method, metric = "pcc",
        realPopulationsOnly = real_only
      )
      .analysis_print_save_fig(p, file.path(
        .analysis_fig_dir(c(fig_key, "heatmaps", pops_key), root_dir),
        paste0("pcc-", method, ".png")
      ), height = if (real_only) 9 else 12)
      .acsCytofSaveThesisFigure(
        .acsCytofValidationPlotCorrelation(
          correlation_tbl, method = method, metric = "pcc",
          realPopulationsOnly = real_only, thesis = TRUE
        ),
        file.path(
          .analysis_project_dir(
            "output-thesis", c(thesis_parts, "acs-tailgate-heatmaps", pops_key), root_dir
          ),
          paste0("pcc-", method)
        ),
        .acsCytofThesisFigureSize(real_only)
      )
    }
  }
}
```
